author: Arjun Krishna
name: JEPA Byte-260 9x512 KV4 seq4096 40k
blurb: Non-record track: first JEPA (Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture) submission. Byte-level tokenization (vocab 260, no SentencePiece), seq_len=4096, 40k steps on 50 FineWeb shards (~12.2B unique byte tokens). JEPA auxiliary loss (lambda=0.1) predicts next hidden representation via a linear predictor head with stop-gradient target. Post-quant int8+zlib roundtrip: 1.2093 BPB, beating the naive SP-1024 baseline of 1.2244.
